messages:
micah: Quick heads-up — swapping the roadmap demo and live Q&A blocks for today's all-hands. Demo now at 10:05, Q&A at 10:20. Also noticed ~1s audio lag in rehearsal, can AV triage?

marco-av: On it. Seeing a tiny buffer misalignment between house mixer and OBS. Will try resync and flip to backup encoder if needed.

anya: Should we announce the swap in the lobby channel so late joiners know?

micah: Yes please, a sticky message would help. Also want to surface 2 leadership Qs during the first Q&A minute: roadmap timing and Dedicated capacity SLAs.

jamal: Re: SLAs — can @jen confirm if the Dedicated latency SLO wording changes before the all-hands? Need exact phrasing for slides.

jen: Short answer: no SLA wording changes today. We'll defer any wording updates to the follow-up email. I can join the Q&A for clarifying language.

marco-av: Quick update — flipped to backup encoder, audio now looks stable in the deck feed. Still seeing one source with 200–300ms jitter (mic 3). Can someone on stage swap to lavalier B?

elena: I can swap mics silently between segments. 

micah: Thanks elena. If audio hiccups persist, we'll cut to the recording-only view and continue slides; call it out in the lobby.

devops-bot: Deploy bot: All-hands stream container image tested at 09:41 UTC, health checks OK. If OBS disconnects, auto-failover to hosted ingest in 20s.

marco-av: FYI for ops — fallback sequence: 1) switch encoder, 2) if retained jitter >250ms for 30s, cut to recording-only, 3) if recording stops, rehost to backup ingest (command below).

marco-av: ```
# fallback trigger
obs-cli --host 10.0.0.5 start-recording || curl -X POST https://ingest-backup.internal/streams/failover
```

anya: I'll post an ephemeral note in #lobby: "Agenda tweak: demo moved earlier, Q&A will start ~10:20. Join us for live questions — we may pause video briefly if audio issues."

jamal: For the leadership Qs, can we pin the two prompts in the Q&A thread so remote attendees can upvote? I'll seed them now.

micah: Great. After the meeting I'll compile the Q&A + follow-ups and drop into #all-hands-summary. If anyone onstage wants to change slides last minute, DM marco-av with slide id (ex: `slides#23`).

elena: Mic swap done. Monitoring audio levels. :thumbsup:

marco-av: Audio stable at -6dB RMS now. Proceeding with final preflight.

jen: Thanks everyone. I'll plan to address roadmap timing in the first 3 minutes of Q&A. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

micah: Perfect — see you all in 10. I'll post the live join link and sticky note in the lobby in 2 mins.

anya: Posting now. Good luck! :rocket:
